items.q: You ______ send the original — a scanned copy is fine.（不必）
items.note: 不必 = don't have to；must not 是禁止。

items.q: The line is down. There ______ a power issue.（一定是）
Last year we ______ copper at a better price.
items.note: 過去的能力 → could + 原形。
will 後面不能接 can → be able to。

items.q: It ______ be the cable — we tested it twice.（不可能是）
items.note: 不可能的推測 → can't be。

items.q: ______ we start the meeting?（提議開始）

choices: Could you send the PO by Friday?
You must send the PO by Friday.
You have to send the PO by Friday.

items.q: I ______ to confirm the delivery schedule.（我想要確認）
items.note: would like = want 的禮貌版。

items.q: We ______ the samples before shipping.（早該測的，但沒測）
They haven't replied. They ______ the email.（一定是漏看了）
items.note: must have + V-ed = 一定是已經。

items.q: You ______ want to check the latest drawing.（很客氣的建議）
items.note: You may want to… 是最軟的建議。

items.q: 我們必須在星期五前出貨，不然客戶的產線會停。
items.a: We have to ship by Friday; otherwise the customer's line will stop.
items.note: 外在條件逼的 → have to。

items.a: The parts should arrive by Wednesday.

items.q: 我們可以考慮改用比較細的線。
items.a: We could try a thinner wire.

items.q: 如果你能今天確認，我會很感激。
items.a: I would appreciate it if you could confirm today.
